Within such <em>dyads</em>, meaning integration, normative evaluation, intentional direction, and epistemic responsibility remain located on the human side, while models contribute probabilistic structural processing, recursive reconstruction,&nbsp;semantic variation, and stabilization of extended epistemic operations.&nbsp;</p>\\n<p>The framework distinguishes these interaction architectures from prompting, conventional software augmentation, and earlier models of distributed cognition.&nbsp;</p>\\n<p>The paper does not claim that language models possess consciousness, intentionality, autonomous understanding, or independent epistemic agency. Nor does it claim finalized empirical validation for the proposed framework. The analysis is exploratory, architectural, and conceptual.&nbsp;</p>\\n<p>Its primary contribution lies in defining a conceptual observation and analysis space for investigating long-form recursive human–AI interaction under conditions of sustained epistemic continuity.&nbsp;</p>\\n<p>The document should therefore be understood as an exploratory working framework situated …
